record.question: The first graphical user interface was designed in the 1970s by:
record.explanation: Xerox PARC developed the Alto graphical interface in the 1970s; “first GUI” is a broad historical shorthand. This refers to the Xerox PARC/Alto graphical-desktop lineage, not a denial of earlier interactive graphical-system demonstrations. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed source and technical explanation audited26October2026. References: https://computerhistory.org/blog/silicon-valley-a-century-of-entrepreneurial-innovation/?key=silicon-valley-a-century-of-entrepreneurial-innovation
